cursor.finding: Supported: knowledgePage decodes/parses before raw length guard; decodeCursor shared by call list is unbounded.
cursor.proposal: At decodeCursor entry return null for absent/empty or raw.length>2048 before replace/padEnd/atob/JSON.parse. Centralize existing Knowledge cap; remove redundant late length branch while keeping structural validation. Both helper callers covered.
cursor.contract: Maximum2048 JavaScript string characters of router-extracted cursor; base64url is ASCII. Absent/empty unchanged. Above cap returns existing route400 when decoder reached; exactly2048 allowed if valid. Call list gains explicit cap. Preserve auth/ownership/workspace/date-filter precedence, knowledge shape/header/order and call list shape/order.
cursor.limits: This bounds application cursor normalization/decoding, not prior URL/query parsing or entire HTTP request resources. Knowledge ownership reads and call workspace/foundation work may precede decoder; no blanket zero-DB-work promise. Historical arbitrarily long generated cursor support is not claimed.

enums.finding: Supported invalid supplied strings silently fall back on PUT kind/status and POST status; malformed strings are not persisted as enum values, but a successful no-op/accompanying edit/draft creation can still charge writes.
enums.proposal: PUT: preserve owned-item and readWorkspaceBody first, then destination lookup/refusal, then reject supplied invalid kind/status before candidate readiness or UPDATE. POST: preserve owned-collection/body validation and required valid kind first, reject supplied invalid status before INSERT.
enums.omitted: PUT retains captured current field, POST status defaults draft, POST kind remains required. Exact values only, no trimming/case folding.
enums.precedence: Nonstring/null already400 in readWorkspaceBody; ownership404 comes first. PUT missing/foreign destination404 remains before enum check. If supplied kind and status both invalid, kind error first. Valid active candidate still requires existing itemReady. Invalid enums400 before quota/row trigger; valid quota refusals unchanged.
enums.preserved: Seven-field/id/business CAS, boolean0->409, SQL activated_at semantics, default/current values, trimming content, response shapes, source metadata, ownership/readiness/storage/quota; no migration or generic validator rewrite.
